We need retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have guidance: step1: sulfonamide formation (amine + sulfonyl chloride). So disconnection: break S-N bond to give sulfonyl chloride and aniline.

Target has sulfonamide linking a tolyl amine (para methyl phenyl) to a sulfonyl phenyl ring (with side chain). So retrosynthesis: break sulfonamide to give tolyl amine (p-toluidine) and sulfonyl chloride (Ar-SO2Cl) where Ar is the second phenyl bearing the side chain.

Step2: amide formation: break C(=O)-N bond to give carboxylic acid (alpha,beta-unsaturated acid) and aniline (aniline attached to phenyl). The side chain is /C=C/C(=O)N-Ph-NH2? Actually C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N: amide linking to an aniline (para-aminophenyl). So disconnection: carboxylic acid (cinnamic acid derivative) and aniline (p-aminophenyl). The acid is attached to the phenyl ring via conjugated double bond: /C=C/C(=O)OH attached to phenyl sulfonyl ring.

Step3: Doebner modification to form the alpha,beta-unsaturated acid from aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid. So break the C=C bond to give aromatic aldehyde (the phenyl ring with sulfonyl group) and malonic acid.

Thus route: target -> (1) sulfonamide disconnection -> p-toluidine + aryl sulfonyl chloride (Ar-SO2Cl). (2) amide disconnection on the sulfonyl chloride product? Actually the sulfonyl chloride product still has side chain: Ar-SO2-Ph-CH=CH-COCl? Wait after step1 we have sulfonyl chloride attached to phenyl ring with side chain still present as /C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N? Actually the sulfonyl chloride is on the second phenyl ring, which also bears the side chain (alpha,beta-unsaturated amide). The sulfonyl chloride is Ar-SO2Cl where Ar is the phenyl ring with side chain. So step2: amide formation on that side chain: break amide to give carboxylic acid (cinnamic acid derivative) attached to that phenyl ring, and aniline (p-aminophenyl). So we get aryl sulfonyl chloride + cinnamic acid (Ar-CH=CH-COOH) + p-aminophenyl.

Step3: Doebner modification: break C=C to give aromatic aldehyde (Ar-CHO) and malonic acid.

Thus final precursors: p-toluidine, aryl sulfonyl chloride (from aldehyde), malonic acid, p-aminophenyl (aniline). Actually p-aminophenyl is separate.

We need 3 reactions: 1) sulfonamide formation, 2) amide coupling, 3) Doebner modification.

We need to provide JSON route with nested reactions.

We need template IDs for each reaction. We have some templates from search results: sulfonamide formation template id maybe 733 (reaction_id). Template IDs are likely numeric? The JSON expects "template_id": number? In example they used 1234. The search result gave reaction_id and template_hash. Probably template_id is reaction_id. Use those IDs.

Sulfonamide formation: from search result reaction_id 733 (retro_smarts). Use template_id 733.

Amide formation: need template where carboxylic acid to amide. Search for functional_groups_broken aliphatic carboxylic acid, formed amide. We got some templates earlier (reaction_id 401931 etc). Use one, say 401931.

Doebner modification: need template breaking aldehyde to form C=C double bond. Search for functional_groups_broken aldehydes, formed C-C double bonds. Let's search.
